title: Dec 7 MoBay vendors protest Grand Market cancellation
exclusion_reason: Observer reports about 30 vendors, below the >=50 participant threshold at a gathering. The demand targeted the municipal mayor’s Grand Market decision, but count is below threshold.

occurrence.value: Protest occurred 7 Dec on St James Street and moved to municipal corporation building.

target.value: Vendors asked Mayor for longer selling hours after Grand Market cancellation; Mayor cited COVID crowd risk.
